generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.explanation: We don't have a one-click fix for this exact error yet. The details below have been logged. Use the 'Report on GitHub' button — your error will be pre-filled so the maintainer can fix it fast.
generic.step1: Try the action again — many errors are transient
generic.step2: If it keeps happening, restart the server (power button bottom-right)
generic.step3: Still broken? Report on GitHub (button below) — takes 10 seconds

page.restartConfirm: Restart the server? The page will reload itself once it's back.
page.githubHint: Open a pre-filled GitHub issue — everything the maintainer needs is already in the body. Takes ~10 seconds.

notFound.title: That page doesn't exist — but here's what does.
notFound.body: The link might be stale (a feature was renamed), the URL was typed by hand, or your browser is still on an old version after an update.
notFound.hints: After a deploy on the server, force-refresh on mobile (Safari: pull down on the tab bar, or close the tab and reopen). If the path is a client or audit URL, you may not have access to that record — try Dashboard or Clients.
notFound.searchBody: Press ⌘ K (or Ctrl K on Windows) for the global command palette — searches every client, tool, audit, keyword, and page in one box.
